meta.name: linear
meta.description: Manage Linear issues, projects, and workflows via CLI. This skill should be used when the user wants to create, list, update, or search Linear issues, manage projects or milestones, or interact with their Linear workspace. Triggers on "create a task", "add a Linear issue", "list my issues", "update GLE-123", "what's in my backlog", or any Linear-related request.

copy.tagline: 管理你的 Linear 任务与项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Linear 跟踪团队任务
copy.tagline_en: Manage your Linear tasks and projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Linear to track team tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以代表你通过命令行管理 Linear 项目：创建、查看、更新任务，添加评论，查询工作区信息等。
howto.when: 当你说出“create a task”、“add a Linear issue”、“list my issues”、“update GLE-123”、“what's in my backlog”等关键词，或提出任何与 Linear 相关的请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个任务，标题为“修复登录页bug”，团队GLE，优先级高。
列出我当前进行中的任务。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can manage Linear projects via CLI for you: create, view, update issues, add comments, and query workspace info.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say keywords like "create a task", "add a Linear issue", "list my issues", "update GLE-123", "what's in my backlog", or any Linear-related request.

say_en.text: Create a task titled 'Fix login bug' for team GLE with high priority.
say_en.note: Claude runs linear create to create the issue.
Claude runs linear update GLE-123 --state Done.
